summaries.zh: Connects DeepSeek Harness to the open-source QingAgent writing client. The agent drafts and revises documents through `qing_` prefixed host tools; output is typeset on a rice-paper side panel (mermaid, drawio, tables, KaTeX) instead of plain chat text, and every edit is staged on the page for review — nothing lands until the user commits. Requires the QingAgent desktop app (MIT, qingagent.com) running on the same machine. Published on npm as `dsh-qingagent` (0.1.47, Apache-2.0, no install-time l
